description: Implement support for joins that don't require strict equality between parent and child key types. Add a configuration flag to control strict-equality assumptions and enable automatic type casting for child rows when needed. This will fix edge cases with MySQL BigInt relations and improve compatibility across different database types.
functional_requirements: Add a 'canAssumeStrictEquality' flag to join configuration that determines whether strict type equality is required for key matching
Implement automatic type inference for parent row keys and inject appropriate type casts for child rows when strict equality is not assumed
Ensure the solution handles MySQL BigInt edge cases where parent and child key types may differ
Update the in-memory join processing logic to use the new flag and casting mechanism
Add validation to maintain backward compatibility with existing join behavior when the flag is not set or defaults to true
Include comprehensive testing for view relations with large BigInt keys, particularly for MySQL-specific scenarios
